environment: Local production build over HTTPS, local Auth/REST stand-ins, real server actions and isolated PostgreSQL
command: PG_TEST_BROWSER=1 PG_TEST_PRODUCTION=1 PG_TEST_PAYMENT_ACTIONS_ONLY=1 npm run test:db
upcoming_panel_checks: Item name heading, amount and certainty, grouped due date and timing
Subscription review opens existing renewal record without completing payment
Service action opens the matching service completion form
Warranty expiry excludes original purchase price and links to existing receipt
Unknown amount opens existing amount editor and cancellation retains unknown
Sample activity review does not save or make payments
Keyboard opening, initial close-control focus, Escape, close and focus return
No horizontal overflow at 320px, 390px, desktop or simulated doubled text sizes
Real payment recording through the panel uses schedule amounts or occurrence overrides
Estimated, confirmed, known zero and explicit unknown amounts remain distinct
Cancellation preserves data, failed saves retain fields, retry records once
Stale amount links do not edit the next occurrence
Existing service payment, cost confirmation, cancellation, retry and recurrence flows
limitations: Hosted Supabase and physical iPhones were not tested
Doubled text sizes were simulated in the browser, not native device text settings
No comparative household usability study has been conducted
Initial test run stopped on an ambiguous vehicle-date locator; corrected earliest-date selection and rerun passed
